skill.name: skill-authoring
skill.description: Guide for creating Claude Code skills that mirror library documentation. Covers sync strategies, SKILL.md structure, and best practices.

generated_query: I’m building a Claude Code plugin to help me during development. I want to create a new documentation skill for the Zod validation library. Can you help me set up the skill folder structure, write the SKILL.md with a quick start and best practices, and create a sync script that pulls the official Zod docs from their GitHub repo (https://github.com/colinhacks/zod) into a resources folder? I need the SKILL.md to include a documentation index table and the sync command, and the script should capture the commit hash and generate a manifest.json. Also, make sure the quick start example is less than 10 lines and the best practices section includes tips like using `z.object()` for nested schemas and `z.infer` for TypeScript types.
